author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

This PR has three fixes for TICL in the default (v5) reconstruction, offline and at HLT.

- `PFTICLProducer`: a TICL muon candidate goes through `PFMuonAlgo::reconstructMuon` with the muon of its track, so it gets the `muonRef` and the muon kinematics. Before, `pfTICL` did this only for a PF muon that is not a tracker muon, or for a global muon of a candidate without tracksters, so almost every `pfTICL` muon had no `muonRef`.
- Electron sign: `TICLCandidate` (in `DataFormats/HGCalReco`) and `SimTrackstersProducer` set the PDG id of an electron candidate with the PDG convention, so that an e- is +11. Before, they used `11 * charge`, which gives -11 for an e-. Charged hadrons were already correct (`211 * charge`). No data member changes.
- `PFTICLProducer` declared `useMTDTiming`, `useTimingAverage`, `timingQualityThreshold` and three track-time maps, and never read them. They are removed from the producer, from the pyTICL presets and catalog, from `iterativeTICL_cff.py`, and from the `HLT_75e33` module `hltPfTICL` together with its `mtd_at_hlt` modification.

#### PR validation:

All the comparisons use the same input in both legs: without this PR (the IB) and with it.

- RECO (v5, `RAW2DIGI,RECO`), 50 events of TenTau PU200 (`ExtendedRun4D127`), the same DIGI file:
  - `ticlCandidate`: 1191 of 97571 candidates change, all of them electron sign flips. No other candidate changes.
  - `pfTICL`: 369 muons in both legs. The muons with a `muonRef` go from 14 to 369. The energy of every muon is the same in both legs. No other `pfTICL` object changes.
- HLT (`HLT:75e33` on the step 2 file of workflow 37634.0, 10 events, 1 thread): `hltTiclCandidate` has 20 electron sign flips. 2 more candidates and 2 `hltPfTICL` objects differ. Two runs of the IB itself differ by 1 to 3 candidates in the same way, because the HLT tracks are not reproducible from run to run.
- DQM, workflow 37634.0 (ttbar, `Run4D127`, no pileup, 10 events), steps 3 and 4 on the same step 2 file, 1 thread. 51 of 59 top folders are bit-identical. The others:
  - Electron sign: `HGCalValidator/ticlCandidates/{Candidates, electrons}` (2 histograms) and `HGCalValidator/hltTiclCandidate` (33).
  - The `muonRef` of the `pfTICL` muons, which feed `particleFlow`: `ParticleFlow` (16, muon offset, slimmed muons and MET), `Muons` (26: `MuonPFAnalyzer/PFvsTUNEP` and `RecoMuonV/MuonTrack`), `Muons_miniAOD` (72), `Btag` (3), `JetMET` (1, `METSignReal`).
title: TICL v5 fixes: pfTICL muons, electron sign, unused pfTICL timing parameters
